name: context-menu
useFor: Use for shortcuts on an item in a list or table (copy an order ID, retry a checkout). Every action in it must also be reachable another way, such as a row's menu key. Use ContextMenuShortcut for keys, ContextMenuSub for one level of submenu and variant="destructive" on a destructive item.
constraints: The only way to reach an action
More than one level of submenu
A context menu on text people want to select
source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.nav-tray) and dropdown-menu.tsx
